title: HomeprofileOptions
description: A home profile option is the option that can be set. A home profile option may have different data types, 'single_select', 'multiple_select' or 'number'. The available properties in the object will change depending on this data type, which is described more in the model.

key.description: Key of home profile. A home profile option is identified by key, hence, it is the value for the key which are updated when running patch

data_type.description: The data type of the home profile option. Eg. if 'single_select', there will be several different choices, where one value should be taken (eg. house type).

value.description: Selected value for the location. A number if data_type is ‘number’, string if ‘data_type’ is ‘single_select’ and list of strings if data_type is ‘multiple_select’. Null if no value has been set.

possible_values.description: Only present if data_type is 'single_select' or 'multiple_select'. The possible values contains all the possible options that can be set.

value.description: Value for the possible value. To be provided in patch

developer_description.description: A string that describes this value. Not meant to be displayed to the end user.

limits.description: Only present if data_type is 'number'. The limit object contains the minimum and maximum value that can be selected, and with what step.

step.description: Minimum step. Eg. if home profile option is to select number of freezers, the user would increase/decrease the amount of freezers with 1.

dependent_properties.description: Only present if a dependent property has been configured. Used to indicated if an option should be shown or not given previous choices.

property.description: The name of the dependent property.

accepted_values.description: The list of the values that are accepted for the dependent property.

tags.description: An array of tags. Currently used tags are `required_for_euc_to_work` and `required_for_sh_to_work`.

developer_description.description: A string that describes this option. Not meant to be displayed to the end user.

is_required.description: DEPRECATED! Use tags instead. Whether the option is a field that is required for similar homes and breakdown.
